title: AGENOS Contract Ingestion Schema
description: LLM MUST output this JSON when parsing a new contract PDF. This output is used to populate the agenos database. Every field has hints, data types, and required/optional markers. When unsure, set confidence < 0.7 and needs_human_review = true.

extraction_metadata.description: REQUIRED. Information about this extraction run itself.

source_filename.description: REQUIRED. Exact PDF filename as provided. Example: 'Complete_with_Docusign_SOW-2-_1MG_X_Voltbek.pdf'

page_count.description: REQUIRED. Total pages in the PDF.

ingestion_class.description: REQUIRED. 'text_native' if PDF has selectable text, 'image_primary' if scanned/photographed, 'mixed' if both.

overall_confidence.description: REQUIRED. Your confidence in the entire extraction. 1.0 = fully certain, 0.5 = many guesses. Be honest — low confidence triggers human review.

needs_human_review.description: REQUIRED. Set true if ANY field below was guessed, unclear, or could not be extracted. When in doubt, set true.

review_notes.description: OPTIONAL. List specific fields or sections that need human verification. Example: ['Rate for Nurse-3 unclear on page 7', 'TDS section not explicitly stated']. After merged-fee splits, note PO attribution vs equal split if the table is ambiguous.

extraction_warnings.description: OPTIONAL. Any issues during extraction. Example: ['Page 12 was blurry', 'Table on page 5 had merged cells']

client.description: REQUIRED. The client (NOT TATA 1MG — the OTHER party). If client already exists in DB, provide slug to match.

legal_name.description: REQUIRED. Full legal entity name exactly as written in the contract. Example: 'Voltbek Home Appliances Private Limited'. DO NOT abbreviate.

slug.description: OPTIONAL. URL-safe key. If this client already exists in the DB, provide their slug to avoid duplicates. Example: 'voltbek', 'tata_cap'. Set null for new clients.

gstin.description: OPTIONAL. 15-digit GST Identification Number if mentioned in contract.

pan.description: OPTIONAL. 10-char PAN if mentioned in contract.

registered_address.description: OPTIONAL. Full registered address as mentioned in contract.

sites.description: REQUIRED. All service locations mentioned in the contract. At least one site must be provided. Each site is where TATA 1MG deploys staff.

site_key.description: REQUIRED. Unique key for this site within this contract. Use pattern: clientslug_city. Example: 'voltbek_sanand', 'gotion_chakan'.

canonical_name.description: REQUIRED. Full site name as written in the contract. Include company name and full address. Example: 'Voltbek Home Appliances Pvt Ltd, Plot SM-12+51/1/2, GIDC Sanand-II'

display_name.description: REQUIRED. Short operational label. Example: 'Voltbek OHC – Sanand', 'Ramboll Medical Room – Hyderabad'

address.description: OPTIONAL. Full street address from contract.

service_category.description: REQUIRED. 'ohc' = Occupational Health Center (factory/plant), 'medical_room' = office medical room, 'visiting_room' = periodic doctor visits, 'cwp' = Corporate Wellness Program.

source_system.description: REQUIRED. Which system uses this code.

alias_code.description: REQUIRED. Exact code as it appears in that system. Example: 'VOLTBEK_SANAND'

attendance_system_codes.description: OPTIONAL. Known attendance system codes that map to this site. These go into the site_alias table.

contract.description: REQUIRED. The contract terms being extracted.

title.description: REQUIRED. Descriptive title. Example: 'Voltbek OHC SOW-2 FY25-28'. Include client name, type, and period.

contract_kind.description: REQUIRED. 'msa' = Master Service Agreement (framework, no commercials). 'sow' = Statement of Work (references an MSA, has rate cards). 'service_agreement' = standalone with both terms and rates. 'letter_of_extension' = extends existing agreement. 'amendment' = modifies existing terms. 'cwp_msa' = TACO-style Corporate Wellness Program agreement.

ref_number.description: OPTIONAL. Contract reference number if present. Example: 'TCL/2024/11/1043'

docusign_envelope_id.description: OPTIONAL. DocuSign envelope ID if contract was signed via DocuSign. Usually a UUID like '7386C17B-F2C4-428B-9B15-53067CFCE70E'

effective_from.description: REQUIRED. Start date of the contract. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Look for 'Effective Date', 'Commencement Date', or 'Start Date' in the contract.

effective_to.description: OPTIONAL. End date. NULL means open-ended (auto-renewal). Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

execution_date.description: OPTIONAL. Date contract was actually signed. May differ from effective_from.

termination_notice_days.description: REQUIRED. Days of notice required to terminate. Usually 30 or 90. Look for 'termination' or 'notice period' clause.

non_solicitation_months.description: OPTIONAL. Anti-poaching period in months after contract ends. Look for 'non-solicitation' clause. Default 0 if not mentioned.

supersedes_contract_title.description: OPTIONAL. If this is an extension/amendment, provide the title of the contract it supersedes. Used to set superseded_by_id.

filename.description: REQUIRED. Filename of the linked document.

doc_role.description: REQUIRED. Role of this document in the contract.

linked_documents.description: OPTIONAL. If this SOW references an MSA, or this extension references the original agreement, list them here.

parties.description: REQUIRED. All legal entities party to this contract. MUST include TATA 1MG as service_provider and at least one client. For multi-entity contracts (TATA Capital has 3 entities, TATA Trust has 5 trusts), list ALL of them.

party_role.description: REQUIRED. 'service_provider' = TATA 1MG (always exactly one). 'primary_client' = main client entity. 'co_client' = additional client entities (TATA Trust has 5 trusts as co_clients). 'payer' = if a different entity pays. 'guarantor' = parent guarantee.

legal_name.description: REQUIRED. Full legal name as written in contract.

signatory_name.description: OPTIONAL. Name of person who signed for this party.

signatory_title.description: OPTIONAL. Title/designation of signatory. Example: 'Head HR & Administration', 'Authorized Signatory'

payment_terms.description: REQUIRED. Payment and tax terms. Source may be prose (IT/OHC agreements) OR a two-column annexure table (common in TACO/CWP MSAs). Read every row of a payment-terms table and map to these fields; use the PDF numbers, not generic defaults (e.g. do not assume 30 days if the table says 45).

payment_due_days.description: REQUIRED. Calendar days to pay after the trigger (see payment_due_trigger). From phrases like 'payment within 45 days of receipt of invoice'. Must match the contract — not a generic 30 unless the document says 30.

payment_due_trigger.description: REQUIRED. Start of the payment clock. invoice_receipt = from receipt of invoice (typical 'from receipt of invoice'); invoice_date = from invoice date; month_end = tied to month-end billing. Infer from the payment-terms table or clause.

invoice_raise_by_day.description: OPTIONAL. Calendar day-of-month (1–31) only if the contract specifies when invoices must be raised (e.g. 'by 10th of following month'). Null if not stated — do not default to 5.

invoice_dispute_window_days.description: OPTIONAL. Days the client may dispute an invoice after receipt, if a separate row/clause exists. Distinct from payment_due_days — do not duplicate payment period here unless the contract uses one number for both.

late_payment_interest_rate.description: OPTIONAL. Nominal annual interest % on overdue amounts (e.g. 18.0 for 18% p.a.) when the table or clause specifies penal/late interest. Null if silent.

gst_rate.description: REQUIRED. GST % from the contract (table row or clause); commonly 18.0 for Indian healthcare services.

tds_applicable.description: REQUIRED. True if TDS applies per contract. If the table row says TDS as per IT Act but no subsection, set true and use review_notes; map 194J/194C explicitly when named.

tds_section.description: 194J = professional/technical (often 10%); 194C = contractor (often 2%). Null only when TDS is mentioned generically without section or tds_applicable is false.

tds_rate.description: Percentage withheld: typically 10.0 for 194J, 2.0 for 194C when the contract states the rate. Null if section unknown.

annual_increment_clause.description: True only if annual fee revision / escalation is explicitly stated in commercial or payment sections; false otherwise.

rate_lines.description: REQUIRED. ALL billable line items from the rate card / commercial schedule. This is the MOST IMPORTANT section — these rows become `contract_rate_line` records and drive MIS summaries and invoices: `contracted_quantity` caps how many employees can bill per line; `rate_amount` and `billing_model` set contractual amounts; `billing_rules` and `billing_rule_text` are read by the MIS LLM. Extract EVERY role, rate, and rule. For merged-cell tables (typical TACO / multi-site Schedule B), **K** = vertical span of the **fee cell for that role** (count **Col B** site rows in that span); emit **K** rate_lines—**one per spanned location row**. **FMO (merged Col D):** headline ÷ **K** on each of the **K** lines (paise-safe) even if cell text names a PO or location — unless the PDF explicitly allocates FMO to one site only. **Regional blocks** (e.g. Chakan–Ranjangaon vs Sanand) each have their **own** Col D merges and **K**; **Sanand:** if **Gotion – Sanand** shares the same Col D merge as **IPD – Sanand** and **TTR – Sanand**, **K = 3** and three FMO lines — do **not** use **K = 2** unless the PDF visually ends the Col D merge before Gotion’s row. **MO (merged Col F):** default same ÷ **K**; **unless** the prompt's **Exception A** applies (fee **label** exact-match to **one** Col B site in the span **and** Col E does **not** force shared MO) → full headline on that site only, 0 on others. **Every** spanned row gets FMO/MO lines per those rules even when nurse column is 0, '-', or NA. **Exclude** HELD IN ABEYANCE. **Sum** of split lines must equal headline INR per merge. **Do not** use ÷K for IT-style **per-site headcount tier** annexures. If rules are described in prose across multiple pages, combine them into one rule per role.

site_key.description: REQUIRED. Reference to site_key from the sites array above. NULL if this rate applies to ALL sites (e.g., medicines for all TCS locations).

billing_model.description: REQUIRED. How this line item is billed. 'rate_attendance' = monthly rate deducted for absence (most common for manpower). 'fixed_monthly' = flat fee regardless of attendance (ambulance). 'per_visit' = per completed visit (visiting doctor). 'per_head' = per enrolled employee (health package). 'as_per_actuals' = cost pass-through (medicines, equipment).

role_code.description: REQUIRED. Uppercase code for the role/item. Use standard patterns: 'MO_MBBS' (Medical Officer), 'NURSE_GNM' (Nurse), 'FMO_MBBS_AFIH' (Factory Medical Officer), 'BLS_AMBULANCE', 'MEDICINES', 'EQUIP_CALIB'. If shift nurses, use 'NURSE_GNM_SHIFT'.

description.description: REQUIRED. Human-readable description for invoice line. Example: 'Medical Officer (MBBS/AFIH)', 'Shift Nurses (GNM) – Chakan'

rate_amount.description: REQUIRED for fixed_monthly, rate_attendance, per_visit, per_head. NULL for as_per_actuals. **Per-unit** monthly/visit rate in INR from the contract (no thousands separators in JSON). If the PDF gives **one total for N identical posts** without 'each' or 'per person', divide that total by N and set contracted_quantity = N. **TACO Schedule B merged FMO (Col D):** use **rate_amount = headline ÷ K** on each of **K** Col B rows in the merge (paise-safe), regardless of PO/location wording in the cell, unless the PDF explicitly restricts FMO to one site. **Sanand / multi-row bands:** **K** includes **every** Col B site row inside **that** Col D span (e.g. Gotion with IPD+TTR when one merged cell covers all three). **TACO merged MO (Col F):** default **headline ÷ K**; Exception A = full headline on one site only when contract-extract prompt conditions (exact label match + no Col E shared-MO override) are met.

rate_unit.description: REQUIRED when rate_amount is set. 'month' for monthly rates, 'visit' for per-visit, 'head' for per-employee.

contracted_quantity.description: OPTIONAL. Headcount or unit count for this line (e.g. 3 nurses, 1 MO). Used as the **MIS billing cap** for employee-matched lines. For a **bundle total** split across N posts, set this to N and rate_amount = total/N. NULL for per_visit and variable per_head when not fixed.

attendance_required.description: REQUIRED. true only for human OHC roster lines: role_code prefixes MO_, FMO_, SR_MO_, JR_MO_, COMPANY_MO_, NURSE_, PARAMEDIC_ or exact DOCTOR/PHYSICIAN/VISITING_MEDICAL_OFFICER (including per_visit physicians on the roll). false for fixed_monthly, as_per_actuals, per_head, milestone, retainer_variable when not roster staffing. Never true if role_code suggests vehicle/supplies: contains AMBULANCE, BMW, MEDICINES, EQUIP, HEALTH_PACKAGE, DRIVER, DISPOSAL, or WASTE.

minimum_units_per_period.description: OPTIONAL. Minimum billing floor even if attendance is lower. Example: 'minimum 20 days billing even if 15 days present'.

unfilled_penalty_pct.description: OPTIONAL. Penalty percentage for unfilled contracted positions. Example: 50.0 means penalty of 50% of rate for each unfilled slot.

ot_multiplier.description: OPTIONAL. Overtime rate multiplier. Example: 1.5 means 1.5x for OT hours. NULL if OT not applicable.

service_charge_type.description: REQUIRED. 'fixed' = flat amount added (Voltbek MO: Rs 5,000). 'percentage' = % uplift on **this** line's base (e.g. per-line admin). 'none' = no per-line service charge. Invoice-level admin (% of monthly invoice) belongs on a separate line: `fixed_monthly` + `role_code` OHC_ADMIN_INVOICE_PCT + `billing_rules.invoice_admin_pct` — not repeated on each `rate_attendance` row.

service_charge_value.description: REQUIRED when service_charge_type != 'none'. The value: 5000 for fixed, 11 for 11%.

actuals_markup_pct.description: REQUIRED for as_per_actuals. Markup percentage on cost. 0 = at cost, 5 = cost + 5%. NULL for non-actuals.

schedule_type.description: REQUIRED. How the schedule works. 'prescribed' = fixed days/times (TATA Trust: Tue/Fri). 'frequency' = X visits per period, specific days flexible (Ramboll: 2/month). 'shift_based' = rotating shifts (TACO nurses). 'continuous' = 24x7 (ambulance). 'on_demand' = as needed (medicines). 'none' = not applicable.

schedule_config.description: REQUIRED. Schedule details matching schedule_type. See examples below.

billing_rules.description: REQUIRED. Structured rules that the billing engine code executes. This is the MOST CRITICAL field. The billing engine reads this JSON to compute invoices deterministically. Must match the billing_model.

deduction.description: REQUIRED. Deduction rule for absences. NULL for fixed_monthly. For rate_attendance, this defines how absences reduce the bill.

method.description: REQUIRED. 'pro_rata_working_days' = deduct absent days against the monthly fee using **per-person** LOP-style proration (most common for desk/monthly OHC staffing). **MIS Summary (MAP-STAFF-CAL fingerprint):** the divisor **T** for `rate_amount × max(0,T−absent)÷T` is **calendar days in the billing period** from system Context — **not** Mon–Fri `working_days`, even though this enum value contains the word `working_days`. That string is an **ingest fingerprint**, not the MIS calendar-month divisor. 'pro_rata_scheduled_sessions' = prescribed visit/session schedules. 'per_shift_missed' = shift-based.

formula.description: REQUIRED. Human-readable formula for reviewers. Example: 'monthly rate prorated for absence'. **Do not** phrase as the only source of truth for MIS divisor T when the line is monthly MAP-STAFF-CAL — MIS uses **calendar_days** from the billing period Context for T.

scope.description: REQUIRED. 'per_person' = each seat tracked separately for attendance/MIS (typical: multiple nurses/MOs). 'aggregate' = one lump for the group with a single pool. 'per_shift' = shift-based staffing. Prefer per_person for multi-head monthly manpower unless the contract clearly bills one amount for the group as a whole.

applies_to.description: REQUIRED. What gets deducted. ['base'] = only base rate. ['base', 'service_charge'] = both base and service charge proportionally.

pro_rata.description: OPTIONAL. How to handle partial months (contract starts/ends mid-month).

method.description: REQUIRED. For **rate_attendance** monthly staffing with `deduction.method = pro_rata_working_days`, use **working_days** here as the standard **fingerprint** (ingest convention). **MIS billing** still uses **calendar_days** from Context as divisor **T** for that fingerprint (India MAP-STAFF-CAL). Use **calendar_days** here when the contract truly bills on calendar partial months in a non-MAP way. **scheduled_sessions** for visit/session lines.

partial_month.description: REQUIRED. Whether partial month billing is allowed.

count_method.description: REQUIRED for per_visit and per_head. How to count billable units.

count_source.description: REQUIRED for per_visit and per_head. Which table provides the count.

count_deadline_day.description: OPTIONAL for per_head. Day of month by which client must confirm headcount.

cancelled_visits.description: OPTIONAL for per_visit. What happens when a scheduled visit is cancelled.

input_method.description: REQUIRED for as_per_actuals. How actual costs are recorded.

markup_pct.description: OPTIONAL for as_per_actuals. Markup on cost. 0 = at cost, 5 = +5%.

proof_required.description: OPTIONAL for as_per_actuals. What proof documents must be attached. Example: ['purchase_order', 'delivery_note']

approval_required.description: OPTIONAL for as_per_actuals. Whether manual approval is needed before billing.

includes.description: OPTIONAL for per_head packages. What the package includes.

invoice_admin_pct.description: OPTIONAL. On the dedicated invoice-level admin line only (`role_code` OHC_ADMIN_INVOICE_PCT, `fixed_monthly`): percentage applied to the **sum of staffing (rate_attendance) bases** for the site/period before GST — i.e. contract wording 'admin % on monthly invoice' mapped to one rate_line. Do **not** duplicate this on each staffing row.

billing_rule_text.description: REQUIRED. Plain English description of the billing rule. Be specific with amounts and formulas. This is stored for audit and human reference. Example: 'Bill Rs 1,35,000/month for 1 Medical Officer. Add Rs 5,000 fixed service charge per month. Deduct Rs(1,35,000 / working_days) x absent_days.'

source_ref.description: OPTIONAL. Where in the contract this rate was found.

confidence.description: OPTIONAL. Your confidence in this specific rate line extraction. Rates from clear tables = 0.95+. Rates inferred from prose = 0.6-0.8.
